You have questions, we have answers. ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/q1.jpg)Michelle from Texas asks,How does Direct Meds work? ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/a1.jpg) Direct Meds allows you to get prescription weight loss medications such as semaglutide & tirzepatide from the comfort of your home. Once you've selected and paid for the first month of your chosen medication, you will need to complete an intake form for the doctor to review and approve your prescription. Once your doctor approves your prescription, our pharmacies will ship out your medication within 2 business days. When you run out of your medication, you simply let your doctor know in your Direct Meds Patient Portal and your Doctor will review your dosage, adjust it if needed, and write you a new prescription that gets delivered next day via UPS or FedEx. \*If for any reason your prescription is not approved, you will receive a full refund. ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/q2.jpg)Sarah from Florida asks,How do I know this is safe? ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/a1.jpg) Direct Meds has taken numerous steps to ensure compliance and safety for our patients. 1. Direct Meds has its own medical director who is a practicing physician and has reviewed our doctor and pharmacy network to ensure your safety. 4. Direct Meds maintains LegitScript certification which is the telemedicine industry's most recognized compliance authority. They have independently verified Direct Meds pharmacies, doctors network and software providers to ensure safety and privacy protection. ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/q3.jpg)Diana from Ohio asks,So how does the signup process work? ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/a1.jpg) 1. Complete the health qualifier (should only take 5 minutes). 2. Select your preferred prescription. 3. Pay for the first month of your prescription.\* 4. Complete medical intake form by logging into your direct meds patient portal. 5. Your medical practitioner is expected to review your chart within 24 hrs and often less than 5 hrs. 6. After a thorough medical evaluation, your provider will determine whether a prescription is appropriate. 7. If your prescription is approved, our pharmacy will ship your medication using 1-day FedEx or UPS. \*If for any reason your prescription is not approved, you will receive a full refund. ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/q4.jpg)Eric from Virginia asks,What States/Juristictions are eligible? ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/a1.jpg) Direct Meds currently provides services to all US States EXCEPT Mississippi and Louisiana where prescription of weight loss medications via telehealth is prohibited. ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/q5.jpg)Jasmine from Arizona asks,How does the pricing work? ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/a1.jpg) Direct Meds partners with licensed doctors and pharmacy to offer competitive pricing on compounded GLP-1 weight loss medications. Our pricing is transparent with no hidden costs or monthly fees. For Semaglutide we charge $297/month. For Tirzepatide we charge $399/month. ![](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/tirzepatide-dosage.png) | ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/q9.jpg)Karen from Oregon asks,Where do my prescriptions come from? ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/a1.jpg) Medications prescribed through Direct Meds are dispensed by U.S.-based 503A compounding pharmacies. These pharmacies prepare medications individually in response to a prescription from a licensed healthcare provider and must follow applicable federal and state compounding regulations, as well as professional standards such as USP 795 and USP 797. Compounded medications are prepared for individual patients when commercially available alternatives are not suitable. They are not FDA-approved, but 503A compounding pharmacies are licensed by state pharmacy boards and operate under federal compounding laws. #### Alert Direct Meds is not able to provide services in Mississippi or Louisiana, where state regulations currently restrict the prescribing of weight-management medications via telehealth. ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/q10.jpg)Danielle from Minnesota asks,How do I take my medication? ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/a1.jpg) **For Semaglutide & Tirzepatide Injections:** You will be provided with small insulin sized needles along with your medication. Your doctor will explain how and when to take your medication during your telemed visit. You will start with a low dose to begin your treatment once per week as your body gets used to the medication and increase your dose every 4 weeks until you are at your full dosage. Medication will be administered by injecting into the fatty area on your stomach weekly. For our non-injectable Semaglutide option, it’s important to follow the correct steps to ensure proper absorption and effectiveness: **For Compounded Semaglutide & Tirzepatide Sublingual Drops:** Use the dropper to place the prescribed amount (typically 0.5 mg) under your tongue. Hold the drops under your tongue for 1-2 minutes before swallowing to ensure proper absorption. Take the drops daily for 4 weeks as directed, with higher dosing options available if recommended by your healthcare provider. Avoid eating, drinking, or smoking for at least 15 minutes before and after taking the drops. Following these instructions will help you get the most out of your Semaglutide treatment. If you have any questions, feel free to contact our support team for guidance! ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/q1.jpg)Michelle from Texas asks,How is it shipped? ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/a1.jpg) Prescriptions received before 2 pm central time will be shipped the same day. You’ll receive a tracking number for every shipment. Each shipment is fully insured for lost prescriptions. The only exception for insured product replacement is if a patient provides incorrect shipping information. If this occurs, please speak with customer service by emailing [help@direct-meds.com](mailto:help@direct-meds.com) or calling us at [(888) 696-7176](tel:8886967176). ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/q11.jpg)Christina from North Carolina asks,How much weight will I lose? ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/a1.jpg) Individual weight-loss is dependent on a number of factors but on average patients using these weight loss medications report an average loss of 1.5% of their body weight per week. Over 12 weeks, it can be as high as 10%. This equates to a weight loss of 10–20 pounds for a 200 pound person. ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/q12.jpg)Megan from Nevada asks,How do I contact support? ![User Avatar](https://directmeds.com/dm-offers-stc/img/a1.jpg) You can reach our friendly support team by emailing [help@directmeds.com](mailto:help@directmeds.com) or calling us at [(888) 696-7176](tel:8886967176).
